object.attr: derived: with documents that are each other's parent, or one that names itself, LINK_NOT_ALLOWED lets links run both ways, so traceability can point down the hierarchy unseen (CF-C21, review Q33).
object.description: If a document's parent documents, followed from parent to parent, lead back to the document, Mellon shall report the validation error DOC_PARENT_CYCLE for the document.
